turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no weekday breakdown for ad spend, so it cannot name the weekday with the highest average daily ad spend in September 2026; the closest metric, Ad spend (EUR), is available per day for 1-30 September 2026 (between 170 and 250 EUR a day). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
